features.name: Regenerative Bite
features.description: As an action, you can make a bite attack against a creature that isn't undead or a construct. On a hit, you regain hit points (minimum of 1) equal to half the amount of damage dealt. Regain on long rest.

payload.name: Regenerative Bite
payload.description: Bite non-undead/non-construct target. Regain HP equal to half damage dealt.
